statement: To verify that files were delivered into a large directory, look up each delivered path directly, or read the delivering commit's own file list. Do not rely only on a directory listing: GitHub's contents API returns at most 1,000 entries for a directory, so a delivery check built on the listing stops seeing files once the directory grows past the cap, and fails silently rather than loudly. Found in review pass 2 of cejel #575 (the cross-repository lesson delivery into Alfred's holding directory, 373 entries at the time, so the cap was not yet hit); recorded as cejel #578. Rule: any check that a set of paths arrived names each path, by a per-path lookup or by the commit's diff, and treats a listing as a hint only.
